college.description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras or IITM) has been given the title of "Institute of Eminence". IIT Madras is a prestigious institution of national importance and a public technical university established in 1959. IIT Madras is a residential institute with around 550 faculty, 8000 students and 1250 administrative & supporting staff. IIT Madras Ranking 2027: #170 as per QS World Ranking 2027 with a score of 59.3. IIT Madras QS Subject Ranking 2026: #62 in Engineering & Technology; #156 in Natural Sciences and #79 in Computer Science. IITM Recognitions & Accreditations : Recognised as an Institute of National Importance. IITM Department of Mathematics has been awarded Silver Level recognition under the CAS University Recognition Programme by the Casualty Actuarial Society (CAS). Some of the Indian Institute of Technology Madras courses are BTech , BS, BSc, MTech , MBA, MA, MS, PhD and many more. JEE Advanced, GATE, JAM and CAT scores are accepted for IITM admissions. 890 UG and 943 PG students got placed in IIT Madras 2024-25 placements as per the NIRF 2026 overall report. IIT Madras has 16 departments, a few advanced research centres and around 100 laboratories organised in a unique pattern. IITM courses are offered in full-time, online, and part-time modes. IIT Madras courses are offered at UG, PG and doctoral levels. For B.Tech admissions at IIT Madras, candidates need a valid rank in the JEE Advanced exam. M.Tech admissions in IIT Madras are based on GATE scores. IIT Madras admissions for M.Sc courses are based on JAM examination scores. CAT/ GMAT scores are accepted for MBA admissions. IIT Madras fees for MSc is Rs 1.52 lakhs. Candidates must meet the IIT Madras cutoff 2025 to secure admission. Quick Links Top Engineering Colleges in Chennai Top BTech Colleges In Chennai Top BTech Colleges In Tamil Nadu Top MBA Colleges in Chennai Why is IIT Madras So Famous? Indian Institute of Technology Madras is nationally and internationally known for excellence in technical education, basic and applied research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and industrial consultancy. IIT Madras holds the distinction of being India's No.1 Engineering University by NIRF. IIT Madras was awarded the title of Institute of Eminence. Check below for IIT Madras ranking, cutoff and placement highlights. IIT Madras Research Park (IITMRP), India's first university-based research park, is spread across 11.42 acres and has over 1.2 million square feet of workspace with several formal, informal, and theme-based meeting and networking lounges to promote and sustain innovation through Industry-Academia collaboration. Students can also have a look at the college list of IIT Madras for a better understanding of their courses and fees. fields.eligibility: To pursue the IIT Madras Online BS Electronic Systems degree, aspiring candidates must meet the following eligibility criteria: Completion of the 10+2 or equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as subjects of study. Students appearing for their Class 11 final exams with Physics and Mathematics as subjects of study can also apply for the programme and join the course after clearing Class 12.
fields.course_details: B.S. in Electronic Systems at IIT Madras is a four-year undergraduate online degree programme. The IIT Madras BS in Electronic Systems has three levels - Foundation, Diploma and Degree. To earn the BS Degree from IIT Madras, students have to complete all the levels. Each level encompasses courses, credits, and assessments, giving learners the flexibility to exit at any level. They can receive the certificate depending on the courses completed and credits earned. However, only those students are eligible for the online BS in Electronics Systems at IIT Madras who complete the first four semesters.
fields.admission_process: Candidates can apply admission to IIT Madras BS Electronic Systems programme by filling in an application form and paying the application fee. They need to apply admission to the Foundation Level through Regular entry and JEE-based entry. For the Regular entry, candidates have to go through the Qualifier Process. Students who have qualified for JEE Advanced 2024 and 2025 is automatically eligible for admission and can register for courses in the foundation level of the BS programme.

fields.course_name: Online BS Data Science and Applications
fields.eligibility: To enrol for Online BS Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras, students must follow the below-mentioned criteria to apply: Anyone who has passed Class 12 or equivalent can apply irrespective of age or academic background. School students who have appeared for their Class 11 final exams can apply irrespective of their group/stream/board. Applicants must have studied Mathematics and English in Class 10.
fields.course_details: The Online Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Data Science and Applications is an online programme offered by Indian Institute of Technology Madras, structured to equip learners with a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, programming, and applications to solve real-world problems. Learners are allowed to exit at any level (foundation, diploma, and degree) or continue to the full B.S. degree course. Through the Online B.S. in Data Science and Applications programme at IIT Madras , students gain practical experience through hands-on projects, case studies, and interactive learning modules. Students gain deeper knowledge related to essential areas such as machine learning, data visualisation, and computational thinking to apply data-driven insights in various domains.
fields.admission_process: Admission to Online B.S. in Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras is conducted online. Students are provided entry through regular and JEE-based routes. The regular entry comprises a qualifier process involving an examination for learners to enrol.

fields.eligibility: The IIT Madras BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology programme is open to anyone who has passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics, regardless of age. School students who have completed Class 11 final exams can apply and go through the qualifier phase but can only register for courses after passing Class 12. Individuals holding a recognised 3-year diploma are also eligible to apply for the programme. Candidates can apply for the programme without a JEE score through Regular entry (qualifier process).
fields.course_details: The BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology is a four-year flexible, multi-level undergraduate degree programme offered by IIT Madras. The programme is designed to equip learners with industry-relevant skills in aeronautics, space systems, and allied sectors. The IIT Madras BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology, aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP), gives students multiple exit options, allowing them to earn a Foundation Certificate, a Diploma, or a full BS Degree. The curriculum of the BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology at IIT Madras focuses on theory combined with hands-on training using industry-standard tools. Anyone after 12th can apply for this IIT Madras BS degree through Regular entry and JEE-based entry. Candidates applying through Regular entry need to appear for a qualifier exam.
fields.admission_process: Admission to IIT Madras BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology is made through two pathways: Regular Entry and JEE-based Entry. In Regular Entry, applicants have to complete a 4-week Qualifier Process and pass the Qualifier Exam. Through JEE-Based Entry, candidates who qualified for the current year’s JEE Advanced can directly register for Foundation Level courses.

fields.course_details: IIT Madras is offering a BS Degree in Management and Data Science designed to equip learners with management functional areas and deep expertise in analytics. The IIT Madras BS in Management and Data Science is a four-year degree programme, with an option to exit with a Foundation Level Certificate, the Diploma Level Certificate in Data Analytics for Business, and the complete BS Degree. Designed for students who have passed Class 12 or equivalent in any year with English and Class 10 with English and Mathematics, the courses in BS Management and Data Science will be taught by leading experts from IIT Madras and other premier business schools and industry leaders. Candidates have to apply for the qualifier exam to enrol in the IIT Madras BS Management and Data Science programme.
fields.admission_process: Admission to the IIT Madras BS in Management and Data Science programme is done through two pathways to the Foundation Level: Regular Entry and JEE-based Entry. Candidates applying for the IIT Madras BS Management and Data Science programme through Regular entry have to go through the Qualifier Process to get admission to the Foundation Level. Regular Entry: Candidates have to pass the Qualifier Exam to register for the Foundation Level courses. JEE-based Entry: Candidates qualified to appear for JEE Advanced in 2025 or 2026 can directly enrol in the BS in Management and Data Science at IIT Madras.

IIT Madras is offering a BS Degree in Management and Data Science designed to equip learners with management functional areas and deep expertise in analytics. The IIT Madras BS in Management and Data Science is a four-year degree programme, with an option to exit with a Foundation Level Certificate, the Diploma Level Certificate in Data Analytics for Business, and the complete BS Degree. 

Designed for students who have passed Class 12 or equivalent in any year with English and Class 10 with English and Mathematics, the courses in BS Management and Data Science will be taught by leading experts from IIT Madras and other premier business schools and industry leaders. Candidates have to apply for the qualifier exam to enrol in the IIT Madras BS Management and Data Science programme.
raw.admission_process:
Admission to the IIT Madras BS in Management and Data Science programme is done through two pathways to the Foundation Level: Regular Entry and JEE-based Entry. Candidates applying for the IIT Madras BS Management and Data Science programme through Regular entry have to go through the Qualifier Process to get admission to the Foundation Level.

  • Regular Entry: Candidates have to pass the Qualifier Exam to register for the Foundation Level courses. 

  • JEE-based Entry: Candidates qualified to appear for JEE Advanced in 2025 or 2026 can directly enrol in the BS in Management and Data Science at IIT Madras.

fields.admission_process: Entrance exams will happen in four separate streams covering various areas: 1. Biological Sciences will involve aspects of Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, etc. 2. Biological Engineering will involve aspects of Material and energy balances, Thermodynamics, Biological rate processes (Enzyme Kinetics, Microbial Growth and Product Formation Kinetics, Kinetics of Intracellular Processes (e.g. gene expression, protein synthesis, protein folding), Transport phenomena, Bioreactor design and analysis and Downstream processing 3. Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics will test on aspects of Organic, Inorganic and Physical Chemistry. 4. Computational Biology will test on aspects of mathematics, bioinformatics and computing. Candidates will be short-listed for the interview based on performance in the screening test(s). Final decision on selection will be made based on overall performance.

college.description: Indian Institute of Science Bangalore was founded in 1909. IISc Bangalore campus spreads over 434 acres of land. IISc is also deemed to be a university and offers courses in various streams such as Management and Business Administration, Sciences, Engineering and Architecture and Animation and Design. # 221 in IISc Bangalore QS World Ranking 2027 with 53.8 score . IISC Bangalore is ranked 43rd in the Asian University Ranking 2026. IISc Bangalore Ranking 2026: #129 in Engineering & Technology; #125 in Natural Sciences; #116 in Computer Science and #401-450 in Business & Management Studies by QS Subject ranking 2026 . #1st in the university and research category as per IISc Bangalore NIRF Ranking 2025 . IISc Accreditations & Recognitions: The university is recognised as an institute of excellence and has NAAC accreditation. BSc, BTech, MSc, MTech , MDes, Integrated PhD and PhD are courses of Indian Institute of Science. IISc fee structure for 4 years BSc course is Rs 60,800, and for the MDes is Rs 41,600 Admissions at Indian Institute of Science Bangalore: JEE Main, JEE Advance, IISER Aptitude Test, NEET-UG, GATE and CEED scores are considered for admissions. 3 UG 4-year, 14 PG 1-year, 555 PG 2-year and 15 PG 3-year students got placed during placements at IISc Bangalore as per NIRF 2026 overall placements. IISc Bangalore courses include BSc, MSc, MTech, MDes and PhD. Each of these IISc Bangalore undergraduate and postgraduate programmes is offered in various specialisations. IISc Bangalore admission criteria are entrance-based. To qualify for admission at IISc Bangalore the candidate must meet the minimum eligibility criteria as stipulated by IISc Bangalore and also clear certain entrance examinations like JEE Main /JAM/ IISER Aptitude Test / GATE/ CEED / NEET UG, and so on. Students meeting the IISc Bangalore eligibility requirements can fill out the application form. IISc Bangalore fees for the MTech programme are Rs 41,600. IISc Bangalore provides good placement opportunities to final-year students. IISc Bangalore also offers various facilities on campus for students, staff and faculty members, including hostels and accommodations, library, laboratories, sports, and many others. college.description: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IITB) is an autonomous institute and deemed university governed by a board of governors, chaired by the president of India. In 1958, IIT Bombay was established as part of a government initiative, and it received significant support from UNESCO and the government of the USSR. IIT Bombay QS World Ranking 2027: 134th rank with a score of 63.9. IIT Bombay QS Subject Ranking 2026 : #42nd in Engineering & Technology; 345th in Arts & Humanities; 84th in Business & Economics; #175 in Economics & Econometrics; #78 in Natural Sciences; #44 in Computer Science; #201-250 in Education; #251-300 in Sociology and #51-100 in Statistics & Operational Research. Courses of IITB are B.Tech , BS, B.Tech+M.Tech, BDes, M.Tech , M.Sc, MBA and Ph.D. JEE Advanced, UCEED, GATE, JAM and CEED are accepted for the IIT Bombay admission process. As per the NIRF 2026 report , UG students got placed with a median package of Rs 20,20,860 and PG students got placed with a median package of Rs 18,00,000 . IIT Bombay Virtual Lab: Chemical Engineering Lab , Single Board Heater System Lab, Digital Applications Lab, Digital Logic Design Lab (Logic Gates & Mux-Demux), Heat Transfer Lab (New), Engineering Physics Lab I (New), Systems of Linear Equations Lab (New) are included in vlab IIT Bombay. Students are offered a stipend of Rs 15,000 per month in the IIT Bombay summer internship 2026. IIT Bombay courses include BTech, MTech, BTech+MTech, BDes, MDes, MBA, BS, Executive MBA, MSc, MA, PhD and many more. Courses of IIT Bombay are offered in full-time mode, part-time mode and online modes. IIT Bombay has 17 departments, 35+ centres, 3 interdisciplinary programmes and 1 academic advisory. IIT Bombay fees range from Rs 1.14 lakhs to Rs 8.69 lakhs. IIT Bombay Admissions to the B.Tech programme are based on the performance of candidates in JEE Advanced, while UCEED scores are required for B.Des admissions at IITB . For M.Tech and M.Sc courses in IIT Bombay, valid GATE and JAM scores are necessary, respectively. Candidates must meet the IIT Bombay cutoff for admissions. For IIT Bombay course admissions to the PhD programme, candidates must take a written test followed by an interview. raw.course_details:
The aim of this M.Tech programme in Urban Systems is to expose students to urbanization challenges and prepare them for bringing improvement in quality of urban life. The programme will enable the student to understand the socio-­economic suitability of technical (engineering, information, administrative) approaches and particular solutions in orienting urban development on a smarter and sustainable path. This program is expected to create a team of urban professionals who on one hand understand the planning principles and on the other will also know design challenges of urban infrastructure. 

RESEARCH AREAS

CUSE is engaged in interdisciplinary research in the following areas with a focus on urban challenges in India.

  • Planning and Design
  • Policy and Governance
  • Social and Physical Infrastructure
  • Built Environment and Buildings
  • Informatics

college.description: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is one of the 23 IITs established to be the centre of excellence for training, research and development. IIT Delhi was established in 1961. IITD has 15+ departments and 10+ centres. IIT-Delhi Abu Dhabi campus is a step taken towards internationalising India’s education. IIT Delhi secured 118th position in QS World Ranking 2027 . IIT Delhi QS Subject Ranking 2026 is 36th in Engineering & Technology, 71st in Business & Economics, 91st in Natural Sciences, 45th in Computer Science , 151-200th in Sociology and 51-100th in Statistics & Operational Research. IIT Delhi campus area in acres is 320 acres. IITD has been recognised as an Institute of National Importance and Institute of Eminence by the Government of India. B.Tech , B.Des, M.Tech, M.Sc, MBA , MDes, MA, and PhD are popular courses of IIT Delhi. Total Fees of IITD for BTech is Rs 8.55 lakhs, and M.Tech fees is Rs 1.02 lakhs . IIT Delhi fees for BDes is Rs 8.55 Lakhs, MDes fees is Rs 1.02 lakhs, and MBA fees are Rs 12.90 lakhs. JEE Advanced, UCEED, GATE, JAM, CEED and CAT are entrance exams accepted for admission at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi. Students secured 1,275 job offers during IIT Delhi placements, including over 300 pre-placement offers . About 1,140 individual students have been placed; the drive will continue in 2026. Since its inception, more than 63,000 students have graduated from IIT Delhi in various disciplines, including Engineering, Physical Sciences, Management, and Humanities & Social Sciences. Courses of IIT Delhi are available in full-time, online, and part-time modes. IIT Delhi admission to the B.Tech programmes is based on valid JEE Advanced scores. Admission to M.Tech and MS programmes in IIT Delhi requires GATE scores, while CEED scores are considered for M.Des programmes. For IIT Delhi MBA admissions, valid CAT scores are necessary. IIT Delhi has a placement cell that organises various training sessions and skill development programmes. 818 UG 4-year students, 103 UG 5-year students and 641 PG students got placed according to the IIT Delhi placements 2024-25 in NIRF 2026 overall report. Quick Links Top M.Tech Colleges in Delhi Top B.Tech Colleges in Delhi Best Engineering Colleges in Delhi Best MBA Colleges in Delhi IIT Delhi Ranking Highlights 2027 IIT Delhi has secured its position in the QS World Ranking 2027, QS Subject Ranking 2026, and NIRF ranking 2025. Indian Institute of Technology Delhi ranked 118th overall in the QS World Ranking 2027 with a score of 65.7 . Check the details below of IIT Delhi QS world ranking 2027, along with their scores. IIT Delhi QS World Ranking 2027 Particulars Score Rank Academic Reputation 64.6 157 Employer Reputation 96.9 39 Faculty Student 17.2 801+ Citations per Faculty 97.3 60 International Faculty 3.4 801+ International Students 1.7 801+ International Research Network 66.5 647 Employment Outcomes 59.6 280 Sustainability 81.2 205= Overall 65.7 118 IIT Delhi QS World Ranking Comparison Particulars 2027 2026 QS World Ranking 118 123 QS score 65.7 65.5 IIT Delhi QS Ranking 2026 QS Subject ranking 2026 of IIT Delhi is 36 in Engineering & Technology, 71 in Business & Economics, 91 in Natural Sciences and 45 in Computer Science. The QS World ranking of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi has improved from 150 to 123 as per QS World ranking 2026. The overall score of IIT Delhi is 65.5 in the QS World ranking 2026. The table given below shows a comparative analysis of the IIT Delhi QS ranking in 2026 and 2025. IIT Delhi QS Subject Ranking Comparison Stream 2026 2025 Engineering & Technology 36 26 Business & Economics 71 92 Economics & Econometrics 103 125 Natural Sciences 91 146 Computer Science 45 64 Sociology 151-200 251-300 Statistics & Operational Research 51-100 51-100 IIT Delhi QS Subject Score Analysis 2026 Stream QS score 2026 Engineering & Technology 81.2 Economics & Econometrics 71.7 Natural Sciences 76.8 Computer Science 73.7 IIT Delhi NIRF Ranking 2025 IIT Delhi has been ranked 2nd in engineering, 8th in SDG, 3rd in research and 4th in the overall and management category in NIRF ranking 2025. As per NIRF Rankings 2024, IIT Delhi has secured 2nd in the Engineering, 4th position overall and 3rd in Research. IIT Delhi has ranked 7th in Innovation by NIRF 2024. Under the management colleges, the IIT ranking has improved from 5th to 4th position in 2024. Candidates can refer to the table given below for a comparative analysis of IIT Delhi NIRF rankings in 2025, 2024 and 2023. IIT Delhi NIRF Ranking Comparison Category 2025 2024 Overall 4 4 Engineering 2 2 Management 4 4 Research 3 - SDG 8 - Innovation - 7 IIT Delhi NIRF Score Analysis Category 2025 2024 Overall 80.67 80.31 Engineering 85.74 86.66 Management 78.94 76.25 Research 80.42 81.08 IIT Delhi Campus Life The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus extends over an area of 320 acres. Tastefully laid out with its picturesque landscape and numerous buildings of various types, the campus presents a spectacle of harmony in architecture and natural beauty, thanks to clean and wide roads. The campus area has been divided into four functional zones: Residential zone for students, Residential zone for the faculty and other supporting staff, Academic zone for academic buildings and workshops and Cultural-cum-social and recreational zone for students. Students can also check the college list of IIT Delhi to know about their departments and programmes. IIT Delhi Cutoff Highlights 2026 Indian Institute of Technology Delhi cutoff varies from one category to another. IIT Delhi JEE Advanced cutoff 2026 ranges from 128 to 12730 in round 5 for general category students. The details of IIT Delhi cutoff in 2026 for the general category are given below. Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Biochemical Engineering and Biotechnology is a four-year full-time undergraduate course and it is offered by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi.

The Department offers a unique blend of scientific expertise in applied biological sciences, chemical, and biochemical engineering. It strives for application of this expertise to evolve various biotechnological products, processes, and services through:

  • Generation of highly trained human resources capable of quantitative analysis of biological systems to facilitate their role in manning modern bioprocess industries and to provide an integrated approach to research and development in biotechnology.
  • Evolving research and development programs to develop products and provide services in bioenergy, environment, and therapeutics.   
  • Leading global innovations in Bioprocess Technology, Applied Biological Sciences, and facilitate participation in industrial consulting and sponsored research. Dissemination of knowledge generated through short-term courses, workshops, and conferences.

college.description: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) is one of the premier institutions established by the Government of India. IITK was established in 1959 and recognised as an Institute of National Importance. IIT Kanpur campus area in acres is 1055 acres with a faculty strength of 555 and 47 visiting faculty. IIT Kanpur offers 400+ courses in online, part-time and full-time modes. IIT Kanpur ranking is 221st by QS World Ranking 2027 . Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur courses are B.Tech , BS MS, M.Tech , MBA, PhD , and more. As per the admission criteria of IIT Kanpur, students get selected on the basis of their performance in entrance examinations . IIT Kanpur CSE cutoff 2026 has 32 and 276 as opening and closing rank in round 1. During Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur placement in 2026, out of 1,969 registered students, total of 1,078 students were placed . Some of the IIT Kanpur courses include B.Tech, B.Tech MBA, BS, B.Tech. M.Tech, BS MS, M.Tech, M.Sc, M.Des, MBA, MS, and PhD. Admissions to the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur for B.Tech programmes are done based on JEE Advanced scores. Admissions to M.Tech courses are through GATE while M.Sc admissions are done through JAM . CEED scores are considered for M.Des admissions. MBA admissions are done through valid CAT scores. Every year the IIT Kanpur cutoff varies for each programme and each category. Students are advised to check the IIT Kanpur fees before applying for admissions. Candidates have to meet the IIT Kanpur cutoff to get admission. Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur admission to PhD programmes is done based on candidate performance in written test followed by the interview process. fields.course_details: The Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech.) in Mechanical Engineering is a 4 year program comprising of 8 semesters. The undergraduate degree programs in Mechanical Engineering have a strong flavor on design and hands-on experience. The programs include a deeper study of a number of engineering sciences to which students are introduced at the core curriculum level, theoretical and experimental solution of physical problems, and design of systems relevant to the contemporary industries. The areas introduced by the department include Energy Conversion and Power Systems, Heat Transfer and Fluid Mechanics, Mechanics of Solids, Manufacturing Science, Industrial Engineering, Automatic Controls and Engineering Design and Optimization. Besides the theoretical and laboratory based curriculum, students complete an advanced design project in the final year of the program.

fields.course_details: The B.Tech program in chemical engineering consists of a four semester course work in basic and life sciences, engineering, humanities, and computer application, followed by a two year professional program that includes chemical engineering courses and interdisciplinary electives. In addition, our students carry out research projects for credit or informally to gain practical knowledge. On an average, about seventy to seventy five students graduate every year. Further, a student fulfilling a minimum academic requirement may transition to a double major program, which requires additional coursework and extends the duration of study to five years. All students are enrolled to the four year B. Tech program. Fulfilling a minimum academic requirement, an undergraduate may switch to a 5-year B. Tech-M. Tech dual degree program during later part of the study. Students transitioning to dual degree satisfy eligibility and academic requirements of the master’s program in addition to those of the undergraduate degree. The first four years of the study is almost identical to B.Tech course work whereas the remaining two semesters and two summer terms are devoted entirely to thesis. An undergraduate in chemical engineering may choose to enroll in master’s program of any engineering, science, humanities, or management program in the institute. An undergraduate majoring in chemical engineering may also receive a minor’s degree from another engineering or science program. This requires completing 24-36 credits in the second program along with course requirements in chemical engineering.
fields.admission_process: Admissions for B.Tech. program is made once a year through Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Advanced) conducted on an All India level.

fields.course_details: Bachelor of Technology in Materials Science and Engineering is four years (8 Semester) full-time undergraduate engineering program offered by Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur. A relatively novel undergraduate programme in Materials Science and Engineering at I.I.T. Kanpur has been designed to train engineering graduates who would be effective in meeting the emerging trends in our country in advanced materials as well as in Metallurgical Engineering. The programme is aimed at providing a basic understanding of the principles underlying materials characterization, structure- property relationship, synthesis and processing of different types materials, and extraction and refining of metals. An indepth study of the area of special interest of the student is undertaken through departmental elective courses and project work. This is supplemented by industrial training for six weeks during the summer preceeding the fourth year of the programme and educational tour during the third year of the programme and guest lectures in various courses from engineers working in industries. The laboratory experiments form an important part of the undergraduate curriculum, which helps students in understanding the basic principles more thoroughly. Project work, both experimental and computer based, in the fourth year of the programme, enables the students to carry out independent research utilizing various skills learnt in the programme.
fields.admission_process: Admissions for B.Tech. program is made once a year through Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Advanced) conducted on an All India level.

fields.eligibility: Candidates applying for the Online M.Tech in Smart Grid at IIT Kanpur must meet the following eligibility criteria: A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering is required, preferably with knowledge of Power Engineering or relevant work experience in the power sector. Students must have a minimum of 55% marks or 5.5 CPI in the qualifying degree. Admission can be through a valid GATE score or IIT Kanpur’s online entrance test, followed by an interview (as applicable). Candidates with more than 5 years of relevant work experience or those nominated by government, defence, or recognised organisations may also be considered as per the institute's rules.
fields.course_details: The Online M.Tech in Smart Grid at IIT Kanpur is a postgraduate engineering programme for graduates and working professionals. The programme can be completed in 2 to 4 years at a flexible, self-paced schedule. IIT Kanpur MTech course online covers modern power systems, smart grid technology, power automation, and the use of digital and communication systems in electricity networks. It helps students understand how traditional power systems are evolving into smarter, more efficient energy systems. Online MTech in Smart Grid at IIT Kanpur is offered online, allowing students to study flexibly while continuing their jobs or other commitments. After completing the course, students can work in roles such as Power System Engineer, Smart Grid Engineer, Energy Analyst, Electrical Design Engineer, and Energy Performance Engineer in the power and energy sector.
fields.admission_process: Admission to the Online M.Tech in Smart Grid at IIT Kanpur is conducted through an online selection process. Candidates must meet the eligibility criteria and qualify through the required steps.

fields.course_details: The Online M.Tech in Wireless Networks and Machine Learning at IIT Kanpur is a postgraduate programme offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering, equipping students with advanced expertise in wireless communication systems, and artificial intelligence applications. The programme prepares students to develop intelligent communication systems for next-generation networks such as 5G, 6G, and IoT. The Online M.Tech Wireless Networks and Machine Learning programme at IIT Kanpur blends rigorous theoretical coursework with hands-on exposure through lab simulations, and industry-relevant projects. The programme aims to advance the technical skills of learners in wireless communication, signal processing, and data-driven network design.
fields.admission_process: Admission to the Online M.Tech Wireless Networks and Machine Learning programme at IIT Kanpur is conducted entirely online. college.description: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur was established in 1951 by the Ministry of HRD, Government of India. IIT Kharagpur offers courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels. The courses at IIT Kgp are offered in the streams of Engineering, Sciences, Humanities, and more. IIT Kharagpur ranking is 64th position under Engineering and Technology stream by QS Ranking 2026. Courses offered by Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur are B.Tech , BS, B.Sc M.Sc, B.Arch , BS MS, B.Tech M.Tech, M.E/M.Tech , and PhD . There are many facilities like hostels, medical, library, auditorium, sports, cafeteria, and more are available at IIT Kharagpur campus . Students get admissions at Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur on the basis of marks scored in JEE Advanced /GATE/ JAM /CLAT PG/CAT/GMAT . As per round wise IIT Kgp B.Tech cutoff, the round 1 JEE Advanced cutoff 2026 was 1026 for AI branch and 5426 for Chemical Engineering branch, and so on. During IIT Kharagpur summer placements 2024-26, the average package offered was Rs 1.79 lakhs . Candidates can sign in into the zimbra IIT KGP to get connected with institute via email for all kind of updates. Some of the IIT Kharagpur courses are B.Tech, BS, B.Sc, M.Sc, B.Arch, BS MS, B.Tech M.Tech, M.E/M.Tech, and PhD. Candidates seeking IIT Kharagpur admission must meet the eligibility criteria for the desired course and appear for the entrance examination. Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur accepts scores of JEE Advanced/GATE/JAM for admission to its courses. Admission to B.Tech courses is done through JoSAA counselling in several rounds. The MBA course at IIT Kharagpur is offered by VGSOM IIT Kharagpur . To know more about the admission process can visit IIT Kharagpur college list and fill up the application form. To proceed with the next stage of the admission process the candidates should meet the cutoff requirement of IIT Kharagpur. The candidates will be shortlisted for IIT Kharagpur admissions based on the scores secured in the entrance examination. IIT Kharagpur fees vary from course to course. The admission will be based on either GATE Score only or GATE Score (70 % weightage) and a personal interview (30 % weightage). 

The personal interview will be held to test the following: 

(a) Motivation and aptitude for the Programme 

(b) Suitability for the department/center 

(c) Skills in basic science, engineering, and relevant areas. The personal interview will be conducted at IIT Kharagpur only.

Important Note: For specializations where admission is based on both GATE score and interview, a candidate who fails to appear for the personal interview will not be considered for admission in that specialization.
